# sensory modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sensoryModality`](gmeow-sensoryModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sensoryModality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The sensory channel(s) through which this environment is measured or perceived. Non-functional: a single environment may span multiple modalities (e.g. a space that is both thermally and acoustically characterised), and competing modality classifications coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) -> [`gmeow:SensoryModality`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryModality.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:sensoryModality`](gmeow-sensoryModality.md) from [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) to [`gmeow:SensoryModality`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryModality.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Measured Vs Perceived

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/sensory-environment/examples/measured-vs-perceived.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/sensory-environment/examples/measured-vs-perceived.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-sensory-environment-examples-measured-vs-perceived)#example-slices-extensions-sensory-environment-examples-measured-vs-perceived

```turtle
# --- The environment: same room and instant, two kinds of condition.
ex:env a gmeow:SensoryEnvironment ;
    gmeow:environmentAtLocation  ex:room ;
    gmeow:environmentAtInstant   ex:noon ;
    gmeow:sensoryModality        gmeow:sensoryModalityThermal ;
    gmeow:hasMeasuredCondition   ex:thermalGrid ;
    gmeow:hasPerceivedCondition  ex:feltWarm .

ex:feltWarm a gmeow:SensoryPerception ;
    gmeow:perceptionModality gmeow:sensoryModalityThermal ;
    gmeow:vantage            ex:taster ;
    gmeow:observationMethod  gmeow:methodDirectObservation .
```
